definitions: Any of a number of red pigments, some of which are used as indicators.

blocks.text: Ponceau 2R, Xylidine ponceau, Ponceau G, Red R, Acid Red 26, Food Red 5, or C.I. 16150 is a red azo dye used in histology for staining. It is easily soluble in water and slightly in ethanol. It usually comes as a disodium salt.
Ponceau 3R is an azo dye that once was used as a red food colorant. It is one of a family of Ponceau dyes.
